name: Springloaded Statues (9–10)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-20: The Rakshasa's Court
description: Four animal statues sit on pillars, one in each corner of the statuary, with decorated tiles between them in a seemingly random arrangement.
disable: DC 31 Thievery (expert) or DC 32 Stealth (expert) to disarm the statue while adjacent to it
reset: Each statue resets immediately after being triggered.

offensiveAbilities.name: Iced
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps on one of the plain silver tiles in the statuary

Effect A wave of cold passes through the target, dealing (2d10+13) Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Slithering Shock
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps on one of the diamond-embedded silver tiles in the statuary

Effect A jolt of electricity arcs up from the tile and strikes the target, dealing (2d10+13) Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Yowl
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps on one of the plain copper tiles in the statuary

Effect The high-pitched yowl of an attacking cat echoes in the target's head, dealing (2d10+13) Sonic Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw save).
